mapper.sql: p.*, c.course_name, u.real_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `paper_question` pq WHERE pq.paper_id = p.id) AS question_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `paper` p LEFT JOIN `course` c ON p.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.create_by = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `paper` (paper_name, course_id, total_score, duration, start_time, end_time, create_by, status) VALUES (#{paperName}, #{courseId}, #{totalScore}, #{duration}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createBy}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE `paper` SET paper_name = #{paperName}, course_id = #{courseId}, duration = #{duration}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id}
